title: Redis & Caching
intro: Redis and caching interview questions test whether you understand caching as a system, not just a library — Redis data structures (strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams, HyperLogLog), eviction policies (LRU, LFU, allkeys vs volatile), persistence (RDB, AOF), replication and Sentinel/Cluster modes, cache-aside vs read-through vs write-back, distributed locking (Redlock and its critics), and the common pitfalls (cache stampede, hot keys, big keys). This page is the one to use for any role that mentions Redis or distributed caching.
